zh-CN.title: 聊天快捷操作
items: 锁定、日历、推荐复制与成员状态合为浮动快捷栏，可在个性化中选择和排序
按钮随可用空间展示更多信息，矮屏收起至聊天右上角
聊天详情集中收纳会话置顶、锁定消息和推荐复制入口

en.title: Chat quick actions
items: A floating bar combines locked messages, calendar, suggested copies and member status; choose and reorder it in Personalization
Buttons reveal more information when space allows and collapse into the header on short screens
Conversation details group pinning, locked messages and suggested copies together
